native_notify_alert_crashed: The page's web process crashed twice in a row, so Atlas has nothing to show.
native_notify_alert_ended: The page's web process ended twice in a row, so Atlas has nothing to show.
native_notify_alert_not_ready: The page did not start within {secs} seconds, so Atlas has nothing to show.
native_notify_alert_out_of_memory: The page's web process ran out of memory twice in a row, so Atlas has nothing to show.
native_notify_alert_terminated: The page's web process was terminated by the app twice in a row, so Atlas has nothing to show.
native_notify_alert_title: Atlas could not display its window
native_notify_dock_agent_gone: That agent is not running any more. Pick another.
native_notify_dock_keys_clash: The summon and hide keys are the same; pick two different keys
native_notify_dock_not_built: The agent dock is not available.
native_notify_no_permission: Atlas needs the Screen Recording permission to capture the screen. Grant it in {@common_os_system_settings} > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, then restart Atlas.
